canonical.description: An infrastructure-style API laid out by CRUD conventions, for the Terraform provider generator (SDK-4.4). Widgets are a plain collection, projects are nested under an organization, regions are read-only, gadgets are assembled from `x-terraform` hints, and two operations are deliberately not CRUD-shaped.
